paper_title: Leading Axion-Photon Sensitivity with NuSTAR Observations of M82 and M87
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper reports 95% upper limit |g_agamma| ≲ 6.4 × 10^-13 GeV^-1 for m_a ≲ 10^-10 eV from M82 analysis (M87 gives slightly weaker limit of 8.4 × 10^-13 GeV^-1). This is a mass-independent bound valid for ultralight axions with m_a well below 10^-10 eV. The limit is derived from NuSTAR hard X-ray observations (30-70 keV) searching for axion-to-photon conversion in galactic magnetic fields. Encoded as horizontal line spanning the stated validity range (10^-10 to 10^-9 eV) per instructions for mass-independent bounds.
